notes.title: Space Moth DX v1.01 Update + New Videos!
notes.notes:
Space Moth DX has been updated to v1.01, bringing the following improvements:
[list]
[*]New menu tips showing the difficulty of Arcade Mode (Normal) and DX Mode (Hard).
[*]Default game type is now Arcade Mode instead of DX Mode.
[*]Issue where Shot would cancel Laser if both were held with some button configs fixed.
[*]More blood when bosses explode.
[/list]
We've also added a new Scoring Guide video to the Community Hub, explaining how to maximise your points, and an example 1CC video showing those techniques in action. Go for a new high score!
